GeneratedBy.Description: In order to correct for magnetic and radio frequency field inhomogeneities within MRI volumes B0 corrections are made using the EPIC method, Topup.  FreeSurfer's standard mri_ms_fitparms is called utilizing the B0 corrected volumes. mri_ms_fitparms is then used to generate PD, T1 and T2* and to synthesize contrasts of varying FAs. More information on mri_ms_fitparms is documented here: https://surfer.nmr.mgh.harvard.edu/fswiki/mri_ms_fitparms
